title: Event
description: A calendar event for the VBC-WS church app

subtitle.description: Optional subtitle or tagline for the event

heroImageUrl.description: URL to the hero/banner image (Firebase Storage or asset path)

thumbnailImageUrl.description: URL to the thumbnail image (Firebase Storage or asset path)

notes.description: Additional notes or description for the event

startDateTime.description: Event start date and time in ISO 8601 format

endDateTime.description: Event end date and time in ISO 8601 format

isActive.description: Whether the event is currently active/visible

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the event was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the event was last updated
